managed_gitignore: additive root section; fingerprint excludes user patterns
managed_gitattributes: additive final root section; source resources, VERSION, LICENSE and every generated file text eol=lf, so byte-for-byte ownership checks hold in autocrlf checkouts; static dependency profile adds notices, vcpkg.json and vcpkg-triplets

dependency_profiles.[]: baseline: system libraries only; Windows 4DX imports only allowlisted system DLLs
dependency_profiles.static: statically linked third-party libraries; payload stays one self-contained Mach-O and one 4DX, with THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES/ and THIRD-PARTY.json
dependency_profiles.static.windows=vcpkg: pinned vcpkg.json builtin-baseline, generated x64-windows-static-release triplet (static CRT, static libraries, release only), vcpkg binary cache in actions/cache; installed ports must be declared components with matching licenses
dependency_profiles.copyleft: GPL-/LGPL- ids require exact copyleft_acknowledged; AGPL is rejected

ci_enforcement: python3 scripts/check_pipeline.py before configure, package validation, release authorization, signing and publication
tool4d_success: exact PASS line and zero exit status
